title: thesysdev/openui: an open specification and toolkit for generative interfaces
friendlyTitle: OpenUI helps AI create interactive screens, not just text
summary: OpenUI is a TypeScript project for streaming interactive interfaces generated by AI, with a language specification, React renderer, SDKs and starter applications. It led the day’s eligible AI repositories in the collected GitHub Trending results with 363 stars that day and remains under active development.
friendlySummary: OpenUI provides open tools for AI apps to show forms, tables and other interactive parts while an answer is being generated.
whyItMatters: Product teams can use OpenUI to prototype assistants that return forms, tables and interactive controls rather than only text. Start with a narrow, schema-validated component set and test accessibility, state handling and untrusted model output before allowing generated interfaces to trigger real actions.
friendlyWhyItMatters: Developers can use it to build more useful AI interfaces. Limit the available components and carefully check any action the generated screen can perform.
